subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should GitHub-backed publisher profile displays retain a complete synchronous manifest, or may they adopt a bounded/paginated display contract for large catalogs?
rationale: The source proves the read amplification, but only product owners can choose whether full manifest completeness is a required user-visible contract or can safely change.

options.title: Keep complete display semantics
options.body: Define a bounded or precomputed manifest representation that preserves all currently displayed GitHub-backed catalog entries.

options.title: Adopt paginated display semantics
options.body: Change the profile display contract to request only a bounded page and document the loading behavior for additional entries.

recommendation.title: Keep complete display semantics
recommendation.body: Define a bounded or precomputed manifest representation that preserves all currently displayed GitHub-backed catalog entries.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and documented the partial implementation boundary and are the strongest available owner for clarifying the intended completion contract.
